title: ResonancePersistenceMap, stereo coherence, note ruler, CMakeLists
description:
Implement Resonance Persistence Map, stereo-coherence analyzer data, note/tuning ruler data, analyzer quality-mode orchestration, PluginProcessor analyzer tap wiring, and CMakeLists registration for the phase-I UI/analyzer data pipeline per SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §12.4, §12.6–12.7, §12.8–12.9, §18.3, and §20. This task is the sole owner of PluginProcessor.* and CMakeLists.txt for phase I.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §12.4 (scrolling freq×time resonance excess/persistence intensity)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §12.6 (mid/side energy, correlation, mono-sum loss, side LF accumulation)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §12.7 (note names, string/tuning fundamentals, harmonics, current detected/MIDI note overlay data — not forced param quantize)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §20 analyzer quality: Off / Live / Studio / Analysis (FFT size/frame rate/history only; must not alter EQ response)
- Source/Analysis/SpectralAnalysisEngine.* snapshot + config APIs from g.1 (read only reuse)
- Source/DSP/ResonanceDetector.* excess/persistence fields usable as map intensity inputs (read only)
- Source/DSP/PitchDetector.* / NoteFollower f0 for note ruler current-note fields (read only)
- Source/UI/PercentileCloud.* and Source/UI/HeadroomHistogram.* public prepare/update APIs from i.1–i.2
- Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp existing spectral tap / processBlock order from phase G
- CMakeLists.txt append patterns from prior phases

Implement Source/UI/ResonancePersistenceMap.h/.cpp:
1. Data-only scrolling frequency-vs-time ring: columns = time, rows = freq bins; intensity = resonance excess × persistence (or detector-supplied excess with decaying persistence), not raw level alone.
2. Fixed dimensions at prepare (maxColumns for history length under quality mode, binRows from engine). Scroll by advancing write column; frozen/scan modes mirror PercentileCloud semantics where applicable.
3. Off-audio-thread update from SpectralAnalysisEngine (+ optional ResonanceDetector snapshot). GUI-safe latest map snapshot.

Implement Source/UI/StereoCoherenceData.h/.cpp (names may match style):
1. Frequency-dependent mid energy, side energy, correlation (−1..+1), negative-correlation risk flag/metric, mono-sum loss estimate, side low-frequency accumulation metric.
2. Consume stereo snapshots or time-domain sidebands via processor-provided analysis frames — still no second full STFT ownership if engine already exposes stereo; if only mono spectrum exists, document a lightweight stereo coherence path on analysis thread using FIFO time domain and short per-band correlators with fixed bands.
3. prepare-bounded memory; disable able.

Implement Source/UI/NoteRulerData.h/.cpp:
1. Overlay data only: note names, optional guitar string fundamentals for current tuning, octave harmonic markers, fret-range guides hooks, current detected f0/note from PitchDetector snapshot, optional current MIDI note.
2. Does NOT quantize EQ frequencies to notes. Pure read model for GUI.

PluginProcessor.h/.cpp wiring (append-only integration):
1. Own by-value members for PercentileCloud, HeadroomHistogram, ResonancePersistenceMap, StereoCoherenceData, NoteRulerData (and reuse existing SpectralAnalysisEngine from phase G).
2. prepareToPlay/reset: prepare all analyzer data modules; map Analyzer quality mode (Off/Live/Studio/Analysis) to engine FFT/hop/frame-rate and history lengths on PercentileCloud/ResonancePersistenceMap — Off disables engine heavy work and data modules.
3. processBlock: push analyzer taps into existing AnalysisFifo / SpectralAnalysisEngine and HeadroomHistogram input (pre and/or post EQ as designed); never run percentile/map/FFT on the audio thread; analyzer must not add audible latency.
4. Publish pitch/MIDI snapshots into NoteRulerData on control/message cadence already used for pitch.
5. Do not rewrite DSP algorithms beyond member wiring and quality-mode parameter plumbing.

CMakeLists.txt:
1. Append Source/UI/PercentileCloud.cpp, HeadroomHistogram.cpp, ResonancePersistenceMap.cpp, StereoCoherenceData.cpp, NoteRulerData.cpp to plugin targets.
2. Append tests/AnalyzerTests.cpp to the test target (i.4 owns test body).
3. Append-only minimal edits — no preset/target rename churn.

Do not implement unit test bodies or editor paint. verification_commands left empty.
acceptance_criteria: Source/UI/ResonancePersistenceMap.h/.cpp, Source/UI/StereoCoherenceData.h/.cpp, and Source/UI/NoteRulerData.h/.cpp exist as data-only modules
ResonancePersistenceMap exposes a fixed-capacity freq×time ring whose intensity reflects resonance excess/persistence rather than raw spectrum level alone
StereoCoherenceData exposes frequency-dependent mid/side energy, correlation, and mono-sum loss related metrics with bounded memory
NoteRulerData exposes note/tuning/harmonic overlay fields and current detected/MIDI note hooks without quantizing EQ parameters

Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp owns and prepares PercentileCloud, HeadroomHistogram, ResonancePersistenceMap, StereoCoherenceData, and NoteRulerData; processBlock only pushes taps/FIFOs and never runs STFT/percentiles on the audio thread
Analyzer quality modes Off/Live/Studio/Analysis adjust analysis FFT/frame/history cost only and do not change the audible EQ response path
CMakeLists.txt lists the new Source/UI/*.cpp sources and tests/AnalyzerTests.cpp on the correct targets
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: rewrite Source/UI/PercentileCloud.* or Source/UI/HeadroomHistogram.* algorithms (wire only)
modify Source/PluginEditor.* paint/layout (data plumbing only if absolutely required — prefer processor-only)
modify Source/ParameterIDs.h unless a single existing analyzer-quality ID must be read (prefer existing IDs; no inventory redesign)
broad CMake restructure or rename plugin targets
add audible latency for analyzer taps
force EQ frequency parameters to musical notes

allowed: fixed 2D ring buffer for persistence map columns×bins
lightweight analysis-thread stereo coherence bands if engine is mono-only
embed phase-I data modules by value on the processor
map Off/Live/Studio/Analysis to engine FFT/hop and history lengths
append-only CMake target_sources for UI analyzer sources and AnalyzerTests stub
forbidden: changing audible EQ coefficients based on analyzer quality
